accept.title: Create account
account.welcome-default: Welcome to {site}! Take a moment to read the site's rules and guides, then you're ready to start editing and joining discussions. If you have questions, reach out to the site staff.
admin.account-needs-superuser: Only a superuser can change account details.
admin.account-state-hint: These settings apply to every site on this instance. Only a superuser can change them.
admin.claim-no-user: Select a Wikidot account that hasn't been claimed
admin.confirm-is-staff: Allow this role to access the admin panel?
admin.confirm-lose-admin: You will lose access to the admin panel.
admin.confirm-revert: Revert each of the {n} selected pages by {steps} revisions
admin.confirm-site-superuser: Make this user a superuser of this site?
admin.denied: You don't have permission to access the admin panel.
admin.did-email-cancel-link: Email change canceled from the link sent to the old address
admin.did-email-cancel-owner: Email change canceled by the account owner in Settings
admin.did-email-drop-owner: Email change dropped because the owner changed the address themselves
admin.did-email-drop-replaced: Email change dropped because a newer change replaced it
admin.did-email-drop-revert: Email change dropped because the account's email was reverted
admin.did-email-drop-taken: Email change dropped because another account now uses the new address
admin.email-held: An email change is pending for this account. The new address {email} takes effect on {when}.
admin.email-held-waiting: An email change is pending for this account. The new address {email} hasn't been confirmed yet.
admin.email-hold-sent: A confirmation email was sent to the new address. Once it's confirmed, the change takes effect in {days} days.
admin.h-activate: Links this email address to the account and sends an acceptance link. The account becomes active once the link is used.
admin.h-application-role: Granted when a reviewer approves a membership application
admin.h-auth-icon: Shown at the top of system pages such as sign-in, sign-up, profiles, settings, notifications, private messages and the admin panel. Leave empty to use the built-in icon.
admin.h-badge-preview: How the badge looks in widgets and on profiles
admin.h-badge-text: Leave empty to show the identifier
admin.h-bot: Bot accounts don't sign in with a password. They call the API with an API key.
admin.h-category-permissions: Only permissions set to Allow or Deny apply in this category. Anything set to Inherit, or left unchecked, follows the role's site-wide settings.
admin.h-claim-link: Only unclaimed Wikidot accounts are listed. Creating a link doesn't change the account. Once claimed, it becomes a regular account and keeps its Wikidot username.
admin.h-clear-addresses: After clearing, addresses are recorded again only when accounts next sign in or take an action. Existing links between accounts are removed as well.
admin.h-default-role: Given to new members as soon as they sign up
admin.h-email-hold: Email changes don't take effect right away. Once the new address is confirmed, the change takes effect in {days} days. During that time the old address is notified and can cancel it.
admin.h-favicon: The icon shown on browser tabs. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or ICO, up to 2 MB.
admin.h-footer-license: Supports wikitext. [[module time]] is rendered; other modules are shown as plain text.
admin.h-granted-role: Granted when the status changes to Approved. Choose Site default to grant the membership role from site settings
admin.h-icon: An SVG icon file. Used only when Shown next to usernames is set to Icon. Its color comes from Icon color.
admin.h-icon-color: This color is written into the SVG icon
admin.h-invite-link: A disabled placeholder account is created first. It becomes active once the link is used.
admin.h-language: Used when a visitor's browser doesn't ask for another available language.
admin.h-language-follows: When off, visitors who haven't chosen a language in their settings see the site language. A language members choose in their settings still applies.
admin.h-link-made: This link is shown only once, so copy it now. It's also listed under Invite links.
admin.h-mail-invite: A disabled placeholder account is created first, and a link to accept the invitation is sent to this address.
admin.h-media-domain: Serving files from a separate domain is a security boundary. Use a domain different from the site domain. Using the same domain works, but scripts in uploaded HTML files then can't use cookies or local storage.
admin.h-nav-side: A page name. Leave empty to use nav:side
admin.h-nav-top: A page name. Leave empty to use nav:top
admin.h-new-password: At least 8 characters. The member can change it later in Settings.
admin.h-password-help: Shown after clicking Didn't get the email? on the password reset page. Leave empty to use the default text. Supports wikitext, but no modules are rendered.
admin.h-permissions: Inherit means this role doesn't decide the permission. The result comes from the member's other roles, including everyone and registered. If no role allows it, it's not allowed. If any role denies it, it's denied.
admin.h-rename: Use category:name for a page in a category, or just the name otherwise.
admin.h-reply: The submitter sees this reply in their notifications and under My tickets
admin.h-signup-open: Applies to this site only. Existing accounts and invite links aren't affected.
admin.h-suspicious: Accounts that used the same address are linked together. Drag a node to move it.
admin.h-system-theme: Theme for sign-in, profile, admin panel and other system pages
admin.h-time-zone: Visitors always see times in their own local time, whatever this is set to. The site time zone is only used to work out date filters on pages and for the times shown before the page's scripts run. Enter an IANA time zone name, such as America/New_York or UTC.
admin.h-until: In your local time. Leave empty for no end date
admin.h-verified-role: Given automatically after a Wikidot account is claimed
admin.h-welcome-message: The notification new members get after signing up, accepting an invitation or claiming an account. Supports wikitext; modules aren't rendered. Leave empty to use the default text.
admin.icon-too-large: Icons can't be larger than 2 MB
admin.invite-email-taken: Another account already uses this email address
admin.invite-not-sent: The email couldn't be sent. Check the mail server settings.
admin.ip-ban-bad-network: That address isn't recognized. Enter an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address or a CIDR range.
admin.ip-bans-hint: Banned addresses can still browse the site, but can't sign up, edit pages, upload files, rate, post or make any other change. Enter a single IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a CIDR range such as 203.0.113.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32. Leave the end date empty for a permanent ban. Superusers and members who can ban members aren't affected.
admin.l-active: Allow this account to sign in
admin.l-badge-border: Add a border to the badge
admin.l-for-comments: Use this category for page comments
admin.l-group-votes: Group separately in the rating breakdown
admin.l-indexed: Include in the site index and search. When off, pages in this category can't be found by search
admin.l-indexed-tag: Include in search. When off, pages with this tag can't be found by search
admin.l-is-staff: Allow access to the admin panel
admin.l-membership-password: Allow joining this site with a password
admin.l-signup-open: Allow new members to sign up
admin.l-site-superuser: Has every permission on this site, regardless of roles
admin.l-superuser: Has every permission, regardless of roles
admin.mirror-missing: External pages this site is missing
admin.mirror-referrers: Pages on this site that use it
admin.mirror-scanned: Scan complete. {pages} pages refer to {refs} external pages: {instance} on this instance, {mirrored} already mirrored, {missing} missing.
admin.mirror-shadowed: A site with this name now exists on this instance, so this mirror is no longer used
admin.mirror-unused: Not used by any page on this site
admin.mirror-used: Mirrors in use on this site
admin.mirrors-hint: When [[include :site:page]] on a page points to a site this instance doesn't have, the read-only copy saved here is used.
admin.no-mailer: This server can't send email, so invitations can only be made as links.
admin.no-unclaimed: There are no unclaimed Wikidot accounts
admin.page-no-name: Enter a new name that's different from the current one
admin.page-no-older: This page doesn't have enough revisions
admin.password-too-short: Passwords must be at least 8 characters
admin.reset-votes-warning: Every vote this account has cast will be deleted, and the ratings of the affected pages change right away. This can't be undone.
admin.role-bad-slug: Enter an identifier without line breaks or other control characters
admin.sanctions-hint: These sanctions apply to this site only. Leave the end date empty for no limit; otherwise they're lifted automatically when they expire.
admin.site-bad-domain: Enter the site and media domains as the host names requests arrive at, without a scheme, path or trailing dot
admin.site-bad-language: There's no translation for the selected language.
admin.site-bad-mode: Invalid rating system or tag setting
admin.site-bad-slug: The site identifier can only contain letters, numbers, - and _
admin.site-bad-time-zone: That time zone isn't recognized. Enter an IANA time zone name, such as America/New_York or UTC.
admin.tag-bad-slug: Identifiers can only contain letters, numbers, - and _
admin.tag-category-not-empty: This category still has tags. Move them to another category or delete them first.
admin.tag-category-priority-taken: Another category already uses this priority
admin.tag-category-slug-taken: Another category already uses this identifier
admin.tag-taken: A tag with this name already exists in this category
admin.theme-bad-mode: Style source must be inline or external
admin.theme-bad-slug: Identifiers can only contain letters, numbers, - and _
admin.theme-no-url: Enter a URL when using an external stylesheet
admin.theme-slug-taken: Another theme already uses this identifier
admin.title: Site administration
admin.warn-delete: Pages are deleted along with their history, files and ratings. This can't be undone.
admin.warn-revert: Reverting also restores the title, tags, parent page, ratings and files.
api-bad-json: The request body isn't valid JSON
api-cannot-message-self: You can't send a private message to yourself
api-email-taken: Another user already uses this email address
api-file-exists: A file with this name already exists
api-forbidden: You don't have permission to do this

claim.message-body:
Hi,

Someone is using your Wikidot account to **create a Wikit account**.

Your verification code is:

**{code}**

The code expires in **{minutes} minutes**.
Don't share it with anyone.

If you didn't try to create a Wikit account, you can ignore this message.
email.activate-subject: Activate your new email address for {site}
email.approved: Confirmed. We've sent an activation email to the new address. The change takes effect once you click the link in it.
email.changed: Your new email address is now active and verified.
email.dead: This link has already been used or has expired. Go back to Settings and start again.
email.held: Your new email address is confirmed and takes effect on {when}. Until then, your account keeps using the current address.
email.hold-cancelled: The email change was canceled. Your account keeps using its current address.
email.hold-subject: Confirm your new email address for {site}
email.hold-warn-body:
Hi {name},

An administrator of {site} has changed the email address on your account to {email}. The change takes effect on {when}.

If you asked for this, you can ignore this email.

If you didn't, click the link below before then to cancel it:

{link}

Thanks,
{site}
email.hold-warn-subject: The email address on your {site} account is about to change
email.moved-body:
Hi {name},

The email address on your {site} account was changed to {email}.

If this was you, you can ignore this email.

If it wasn't, click the link below to undo the change right away. This signs your account out everywhere and invalidates your password, so you'll need to set a new one:

{link}

Thanks,
{site}
email.moved-subject: The email address on your {site} account was changed
email.reverted: Your email address has been restored to the original one. Your account has been signed out everywhere and its password no longer works. Set a new password now.

reset.mail-body:
Hi,

We received a request to reset the password for the account linked to this email address. To reset your password, click the link below:

{link}

This link can only be used once. If you need to reset your password again, go to {home} and request another reset.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

Thanks,
{site}

update.banner: This site is scheduled to update automatically at {time}. It may be briefly unavailable.
update.check-failed: Couldn't check for a new version. If this server can't reach GitHub, set an update mirror in pwikit.toml.
update.mail-rolled-back-body:
At {time}, the instance at {root} tried to update from {from} to {version}, but the new version didn't run correctly. It was rolled back to {from} automatically, and the site is back up.

Reason:
{error}

This version won't be installed automatically again. The full log is at {log}. Once the issue is fixed, run pwikit update to try again.
update.mail-rolled-back-subject: Automatic update to {version} failed, rolled back to {from}
update.maintenance: This site is updating to a new version and is usually back within a few minutes. Refresh the page shortly.
update.notice-as-root: The site is running as root. Run it as a dedicated pwikit account instead by running sudo pwikit service install -user pwikit on the server.
update.notice-check-failed: The automatic update check failed. See the log at {log}.
update.notice-check-install: Automatic update couldn't install {version}. See the log at {log}.
update.notice-check-fetch: Automatic update couldn't get the latest release information. If this server can't reach GitHub, set an update mirror in pwikit.toml.
update.notice-check-stopped: The automatic update check hasn't run for over an hour. Make sure the update timer is running, and see the log at {log}.
update.notice-exposed: pwikit runs as root, but other accounts can replace the program it runs and could use that to gain root access. Fix the following as soon as possible:
update.notice-rolled-back: The update to {version} at {time} failed and was rolled back to {from}. This version won't be installed automatically again.
update.notice-scheduled: Scheduled to update to {version} at {time}. The site will be briefly unavailable during the update.
update.reason-auto-off: Automatic updates are off. Run pwikit update to update manually.
update.reason-check-off: Checking for new versions is off.
update.reason-container: This instance runs in a container. Pull the new image to update.
update.reason-failed: {detail} failed to update earlier and was rolled back, so it won't be installed automatically. Run pwikit update to try again.
update.reason-no-number: This build isn't a release, so it won't update automatically.
update.reason-pinned: Pinned to {detail}. Run pwikit update unpin to resume automatic updates.
update.reason-postgres: This version upgrades the bundled PostgreSQL to {detail}. Run pwikit update to update manually.
update.reason-postponed: Automatic update is postponed. It will be rescheduled for the next update window once the postponement ends.
update.reason-skipped: {detail} was skipped. Run pwikit update to install it.
update.reason-too-new: This version has been out for less than {detail} hours. The update will be scheduled once it has.
update.reason-unknown: No information about new versions yet.
